market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver has never traded above $50/oz (2011 high), and reaching $120 would require a >240% gain from current levels (~$33-35) in ~14 months—a move unmatched in modern history. Even extreme tail scenarios like hyperinflation or a massive supply shock are exceedingly unlikely over such a short horizon. The market-implied 6.7% chance is orders of magnitude too high.
evidence_points: All-time high silver price ~$49.45 (2011), never breached $50.
Current spot silver ~$34; reaching $120 implies a 3.5x surge in 14 months.
No credible fundamental or monetary outlook supports such a move; industrial demand growth is gradual.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of silver supply/demand dynamics
